name: Birdcage
source:
An apostle awakens from her artificial death. A lone angel stands guard by her bedside. Though the present escapes her, she cannot escape her past. Is history truly doomed to repeat itself? Is it bad if it does?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260809052727/https://steadfaststar.itch.io/birdcage]itch.io[/url]]
